tail:
Batch 84 authoring is complete. The ten items, A/B pages, proof contracts, source evidence, dependency records, notes, and Step 1 decisions are recorded.

The episodic policy-gradient identity includes \(\gamma^t\), which is required for the fixed start-state discounted objective. Sutton and Barto’s §13.3 gives this factor; Williams’s episodic argument uses undiscounted total reinforcement, so it does not supply the discounted factor. ([Sutton and Barto](https://web.stanford.edu/class/psych209/Readings/SuttonBartoRL.pdf), [Williams](https://gwern.net/doc/reinforcement-learning/model-free/1992-williams.pdf))

Four items are marked `ready`; six are `escalated` pending owner reconciliation of the plan’s omitted factor. The exact task-assigned Sutton PDF was an earlier draft without the policy-gradient chapter. I recorded the retrieval history and successful full-text alternative; the source was not marked dropped.

Scoped checks passed: proof layout, precheck, rendering, statement/reference layout, content policy, coverage, and manifest checks. Whole-run dependency checks remain blocked by unrelated issues: unfinished inventories and an existing level mismatch elsewhere, plus invalid YAML in another owner’s item. The assignment names batch 81 as a prerequisite; the current dependency graph lists batches 80 and 81, which also needs owner reconciliation.

Key records: [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-84.notes.md), [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-84.pages.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-84.proof-contracts.json), [source evidence](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-84.source-evidence.json), and [cross-batch dependencies](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-84.cross-batch-dependencies.json).
